name: white-flow-vscode
description: Airy Light and matte Ink themes with opt-in editor effects and optional workbench styling.

whiteFlow.engraved.enabled.markdownDescription: Add static engraved separators and a faint editor inset shadow. Requires the optional workbench patch and either White Flow theme.

whiteFlow.stickyGlass.enabled.markdownDescription: Frost Sticky Scroll headers. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.keycaps.enabled.markdownDescription: Add sculpted shortcut keycaps. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.backlight.enabled.markdownDescription: Add a static light behind empty editor watermarks. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.toastStack.enabled.markdownDescription: Stack notification toasts, expanding on hover or keyboard focus. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.todoMarker.enabled.markdownDescription: Highlight TODO, FIXME, and HACK tags in visible comment lines. No workbench patch required.

enumDescriptions: Use an encoded SVG stroke via the experimental decoration declaration technique.
Use a flat background through the supported decoration API.

whiteFlow.saveShine.enabled.markdownDescription: Sweep the active tab label after a detected manual save. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.celebrate.enabled.markdownDescription: Celebrate when the status-bar error count settles to zero. Not a build-success detector. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.dock.enabled.markdownDescription: Magnify vertical activity bar icons on hover or keyboard focus. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.focusMode.enabled.markdownDescription: Dim code outside the current function using document symbols. No workbench patch required.

whiteFlow.focusMode.opacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of code outside the focused function.

whiteFlow.lineMist.enabled.markdownDescription: Add a pale aurora band to the current line. Requires the updated optional workbench patch and White Flow theme.

whiteFlow.lineMist.drift.markdownDescription: Drift the line mist while motion is allowed.

whiteFlow.lineMist.cursorGlow.markdownDescription: Add a faint glow around the primary cursor.

whiteFlow.methodBeams.enabled.markdownDescription: Connect same-file calls and definitions. Uses a gutter fallback without the updated optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.editTrail.enabled.markdownDescription: Mark recently edited lines in the gutter and overview ruler, in memory only.

whiteFlow.editTrail.minutes.markdownDescription: Minutes until an edit mark expires.

whiteFlow.riskRadar.enabled.markdownDescription: Underline potentially panicking operations and unsafe code in Rust files.

whiteFlow.riskRadar.ignoreTests.markdownDescription: Skip Rust cfg(test) modules and test functions.

whiteFlow.keywordFlow.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable keyword color flow. Requires the updated optional workbench patch and either White Flow theme.

enumDescriptions: Purple, blue, teal, and rose with vivid OKLCH interpolation when supported.
Red, green, blue, and purple with vivid OKLCH interpolation when supported.
whiteFlow.keywordFlow.palette.markdownDescription: Palette for keyword flow. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.typingMotion.enabled.markdownDescription: Animate each newly typed character as it appears. Only the newest character moves, and only vertically, so the cursor and click targets stay accurate.

enumDescriptions: Use `rise` when the optional workbench patch provides its keyframes, otherwise `fade`.
Blur in and rise when the optional patch is available; otherwise fade in.
Step the opacity in with the supported decoration API only.
whiteFlow.typingMotion.style.markdownDescription: How a newly typed character appears.

whiteFlow.typingMotion.durationMs.markdownDescription: Length of the typing motion in milliseconds. Short values keep up with fast typing.
